description: Huawei modems in modem (stick) mode, USB 12d1 with an NCM, serial, QMI or MBIM function: E3372s-stick, ME909/ME906, MH5000/MT5700. ModemManager owns them (its Huawei support speaks AT^NDISDUP over NCM); plain NCM otherwise. HiLink builds (cdc_ether/rndis only, a router inside the stick) do not match and stay with generic-hilink. QModem lists the 5G modules (MH5000, MT5700) but there is no field evidence yet: not preferred. Radio over AT is the Huawei dialect: AT^SYSCFGEX mode/bands, AT^HCSQ signal

radio.source: Huawei AT command reference (SYSCFGEX, HCSQ); another modem manager 3.2.2 huawei profile; no field report of ours yet
